settings.headline: Accessibility statement
settings.subtitle: I want everyone to be able to use this fictional website.

settings.headline: My commitment
settings.body:
This example site uses landmarks, a skip link, visible focus styles, labelled controls and alt text on meaningful images. Pages are rendered on the server, so they work without JavaScript.

Conformance still has to be tested on your own site.
settings.side: Email elena@marlowe.example (fictional) with the page and what went wrong.
